name: claude-motion-reel
description: A 15-second motion-graphics showreel rendered from code

scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -framerate 60 -i frames/f_%04d.png -i audio.wav -af volume=-2.5dB -vf "scale=out_color_matrix=bt709:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p" -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 22 -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -color_range tv -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart claude-motion-reel-2026.mp4
